1. Run the app: `pnpm exec expo start --ios` (Expo Go). To keep the onboarding sheet, dev menu, and Tools button out of your screenshots on SDK 57 and earlier, and on the URLs you open yourself in step 3, see [reviewed upstream launch guide](https://github.com/expo/skills/blob/7ddc1f5796996e5c7efe2fc3fa9168eb24e8dac1/plugins/expo/skills/expo-overview/references/launch-without-dev-menu.md). On **SDK 56+ both `@expo/ui` and DOM components run in Expo Go** — no dev build, no `react-native-webview` to install; reach for a dev build (the `expo-dev-client` skill) only for *custom* native modules. Stale-bundle trap: a CI-mode Metro + cached Expo Go can show an old build — terminate Expo Go and add `--clear` if a change doesn't appear.
